why: Regression for a relevance/opacity coupling bug in BuildGuardedFacts: a handle bound to a `params` slot is unrepresentable precisely (must be `opaque`), but the producer also zeroed the slot's HANDLE bit, so the whole call vanished from guarded_facts instead of surviving as an opaque-argument call. Relevance ("a tracked handle syntactically flows here") and representability (how precisely the slot can be encoded) must be orthogonal.
a2_contract: The call to a `params` sink stays in guarded_facts.calls[] with an opaque slot for the handle argument; it must not be silently dropped just because the slot cannot be represented precisely.
measured_at: P-037 A2.1 relevance/opacity fix in BuildGuardedFacts (this commit)
